entities.name: PMID:10752835
observations: Porcine graded hemorrhage study: candesartan, a selective AT1 antagonist, was compared with control in anesthetized juvenile pigs (n=10/group); hemorrhage was increased to 20% then 40% of estimated blood volume.

At 40% hemorrhage, candesartan-treated pigs had 221% higher mesenteric blood flow and 244% higher jejunal mucosal perfusion than control means; the accessible abstract did not specify candesartan dose.

entities.name: PMID:11049112
observations: In pigs with an initial 20% hemorrhage, candesartan before further hemorrhage to 40% preserved mesenteric and jejunal mucosal perfusion; comparable benefit was not found in hepatic or renal circulation.
Accessible abstract did not specify candesartan dose.
